# Grida Desktop `0.0.23`

[Downloads](https://grida.co/downloads) · [Join Slack](https://grida.co/join-slack) to learn more.

## What’s new

- Share provider API keys with the Grida CLI on macOS and Linux. Existing Desktop API keys migrate automatically; ChatGPT sign-in stays separate.
- Desktop and CLI now use the same media generation implementation for images, video, music, sound effects, speech and 3D.
- Launch Desktop with `--disable-agent` to use media tools without starting the agent.

**Inbox panel.** The inbox icon opens a panel beside the sidebar with Notifications and Requests tabs. You can mark notifications read or unread, archive them, and open the record. It fills the screen on phones.

**Email access requests.** Requests appear in the Requests tab and are approved or denied in place. They expire after 30 days, and the requester hears every outcome. A member who leaves the workspace has their open requests cancelled.
